content.title: DRVN Q2 Deep Dive: Take 5 Drives Growth, Margins Face Pressure Amid Industry Softness
content.summary: Automotive services company Driven Brands (NASDAQ:DRVN) reported Q2 CY2025 results exceeding the market’s revenue expectations, with sales up 6.2% year on year to $551 million. The company expects the full year’s revenue to be around $2.1 billion, close to analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $0.36 per share was 7.2% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
